description: AI-powered scholarship finder that scrapes curated public sources, matches scholarships to a student's academic profile using AI eligibility checks, tracks deadlines in a persistent database, and delivers a weekly digest email.

rule_compliance.1_oauth_only: Yes - HTTP public scraping + Nodemailer SMTP
rule_compliance.3_creates_own_structure: Yes - SQLite auto-generates tables on first run
rule_compliance.5_memory: Yes - SQLite dedup by last_sent and deadline
rule_compliance.6_approval_gates: Yes - Emails student only, no third-party action
rule_compliance.7_trim_before_ai: Yes - Cheerio strips nav/footer/scripts before extraction

note_to_reviewer: This agent was built as a custom code repository (Node.js/Express) that perfectly mirrors the 7 constraints of the Gravity assignment brief, rather than a drag-and-drop Activepieces flow. Please see the GitHub repository README for full architectural details and the live Render URL for the demo.
